answer: Keeping 157 aliases alive thus means 157 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the spiral quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the opal log publishes the live set and the voyage audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 206 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
